sections.title: MEANING IN CONTEXT
sections.instruction: Use the surrounding information to work out the meaning of the highlighted word.

sections.title: SYNONYMS AND ANTONYMS
sections.instruction: Choose the closest or opposite meaning, as requested.

sections.title: WORD FORMATION
sections.instruction: Choose the correct form of the word in brackets to complete each sentence.

sections.title: COLLOCATIONS AND PHRASAL VERBS
sections.instruction: Choose the word combination or phrasal verb that is natural in English.

sections.title: EXPRESSIONS AND COMMONLY CONFUSED WORDS
sections.instruction: Pay attention to the meaning and natural use of each expression or word.

questions.prompt: The once-thriving market began to deteriorate after the main road was closed. Many shops lost customers, and several stalls were left empty. The word “deteriorate” is closest in meaning to ....
questions.explanation:
Skill: Meaning in Context.

Penjelasan: “deteriorate” berarti memburuk. Petunjuknya adalah banyak toko kehilangan pelanggan dan beberapa kios menjadi kosong.

questions.prompt: Her explanation was remarkably coherent. Although the topic was complicated, everyone could follow how one idea connected to the next. The word “coherent” is closest in meaning to ....
questions.explanation:
Skill: Meaning in Context.

Penjelasan: “coherent” berarti jelas dan masuk akal. Kalimat menjelaskan bahwa semua orang dapat mengikuti hubungan antara satu gagasan dan gagasan berikutnya.

questions.prompt: The school introduced extra study sessions to mitigate the effects of the long classroom closure. The word “mitigate” is closest in meaning to ....
questions.explanation:
Skill: Meaning in Context.

Penjelasan: “mitigate” berarti mengurangi dampak atau tingkat keparahan sesuatu. Sesi belajar tambahan dibuat untuk mengurangi akibat penutupan kelas yang lama.

questions.prompt: At first, Dimas was reluctant to join the debate team. He worried that he would make mistakes in front of other students. The word “reluctant” is closest in meaning to ....
questions.explanation:
Skill: Meaning in Context.

Penjelasan: “reluctant” berarti enggan atau ragu untuk melakukan sesuatu. Dimas khawatir akan membuat kesalahan, sehingga ia tidak langsung mau bergabung.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to “meticulous”?
questions.explanation:
Skill: Synonym.

Penjelasan: “meticulous” berarti sangat teliti dan memperhatikan detail. “Thorough and careful” memiliki makna yang paling dekat.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to “substantial” in the sentence: “The project requires a substantial amount of funding”?
questions.explanation:
Skill: Synonym.

Penjelasan: “substantial” dalam kalimat ini berarti besar atau cukup banyak. “Considerable” juga berarti dalam jumlah yang cukup besar.

questions.prompt: Which word is the opposite of “temporary”?
questions.explanation:
Skill: Antonym.

Penjelasan: “temporary” berarti sementara, sedangkan “permanent” berarti tetap atau berlangsung dalam waktu lama.

questions.prompt: Which word is the opposite of “diminish”?
questions.explanation:
Skill: Antonym.

Penjelasan: “diminish” berarti berkurang atau menjadi lebih kecil. Lawannya adalah “increase”, yaitu bertambah atau meningkat.

questions.prompt: After a long discussion, the committee reached a ______ decision. (UNANIMITY)
questions.explanation:
Skill: Word Formation.

Penjelasan: Bagian kosong menjelaskan kata benda “decision”, jadi kita membutuhkan adjective (kata sifat). Bentuk yang tepat dari “unanimity” adalah “unanimous”, yang berarti disetujui oleh semua anggota.

questions.prompt: The speaker presented her ideas with great ______, answering every question calmly. (CONFIDENT)
questions.explanation:
Skill: Word Formation.

Penjelasan: Setelah “with great” dibutuhkan noun (kata benda). “Confidence” berarti rasa percaya diri.

questions.prompt: The instructions were written so ______ that even first-time users could follow them. (SIMPLE)
questions.explanation:
Skill: Word Formation.

Penjelasan: Kata tersebut menjelaskan bagaimana instruksi ditulis, sehingga dibutuhkan adverb (kata keterangan). “Simply” adalah bentuk adverb dari “simple”.

questions.prompt: The sudden ______ of the old bridge forced the town to close the road. (COLLAPSE)
questions.explanation:
Skill: Word Formation.

Penjelasan: Setelah “the sudden” dibutuhkan noun (kata benda) sebagai subjek kalimat. “Collapse” berarti keruntuhan atau robohnya sesuatu.

questions.prompt: The researchers carried ______ a series of interviews to understand students’ study habits.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Phrasal Verb.

Penjelasan: “carry out” berarti melaksanakan atau melakukan suatu kegiatan. Para peneliti melakukan serangkaian wawancara.

questions.prompt: Students should take ______ of the free workshops offered by the school.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Collocation.

Penjelasan: Pasangan kata yang tepat adalah “take advantage of”, yang berarti memanfaatkan kesempatan. Kalimat mendorong siswa menggunakan kesempatan mengikuti lokakarya gratis.

questions.prompt: The committee promised to look ______ the complaint before making a final decision.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Phrasal Verb.

Penjelasan: “look into” berarti menyelidiki atau memeriksa suatu masalah. Komite akan memeriksa keluhan sebelum mengambil keputusan.

questions.prompt: The unexpected rise in transport costs put considerable ______ on the project budget.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Collocation.

Penjelasan: Ungkapan yang lazim adalah “put pressure on”, artinya memberi tekanan atau beban pada sesuatu. Kenaikan biaya transportasi membebani anggaran proyek.

questions.prompt: At first, the assignment seemed difficult. However, in the long ______, the research skills students gained were worth the effort.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Expression in Context.

Penjelasan: “in the long run” adalah ungkapan yang berarti dalam jangka panjang. Kalimat membahas manfaat yang akan terasa setelah waktu berlalu.

questions.prompt: On ______ of the student council, Maya thanked the teachers for supporting the charity event.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Expression in Context.

Penjelasan: “on behalf of” berarti mewakili atau atas nama suatu kelompok. Maya menyampaikan terima kasih sebagai wakil OSIS.

questions.prompt: The new attendance policy may ______ how students manage their time.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Commonly Confused Words.

Penjelasan: Kalimat membutuhkan verb (kata kerja) setelah modal “may”. “Affect” berarti memengaruhi, sedangkan “effect” biasanya merupakan noun (kata benda) yang berarti dampak.

questions.prompt: The number of students applying for the exchange programme has ______ steadily over the past three years.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Commonly Confused Words.

Penjelasan: “rise” berarti meningkat dan tidak membutuhkan objek. Bentuk past participle-nya adalah “risen”, sehingga digunakan setelah “has”. “Raise” berbeda karena biasanya membutuhkan objek.
